title: Configuring Cisco IOS DHCPv4 Server and Relay Agent
summary: Configure an enterprise Cisco router as a DHCPv4 server with excluded addresses, network pools, default routers, and DNS parameters, and configure an IP helper-address relay agent across routed interfaces.
learning_objectives: Explain the 4-step DHCPv4 DORA exchange (Discover, Offer, Request, Acknowledge)
Configure IP address exclusions to protect static devices and gateway addresses
Configure Cisco IOS DHCP pools with network parameters, default routers, and DNS servers
Configure ip helper-address on router interfaces to forward broadcast DHCP requests across subnets
Verify active DHCP leases and pool statistics using show ip dhcp binding and show ip dhcp pool

source.origin: Independently authored network services curriculum guide based on IETF RFC 2131 standards and Cisco IOS configuration documentation
